summary: Architectural blueprint and implementation plan for Kurdish Arabic Academy (ئەکادیمیای فێربوونی عەرەبی), an AI-powered Arabic learning academy for Kurdish speakers featuring dual-track Iraqi and Fusha Arabic curricula, 24/7 AI conversation tutor with Kurdish phonetics, smart mistake correction center, 14 specialized learning views, full Kurdish Badini/Sorani/Arabic/English interface localization, and Google Chat study digest integrations.
